runtime_scenarios.description: Switch source GUI to English and verify translated labels.
Switch source GUI to Japanese and verify translated labels.
Launch the packaged executable and confirm the Data Contract Auditor window and primary controls render.
Load synthetic Baseline and Current CSVs; confirm added/removed columns, type/null/range changes, and duplicate-key findings where present.
Load an XLSX Current input against a CSV Baseline and confirm a non-empty comparison result.
Confirm JSON audit, findings CSV, and generated contract exist, reopen, and match the visible findings summary.
Submit a synthetic duplicate-header CSV and confirm a visible error without modifying inputs.
Close the app normally and relaunch it; confirm the second launch renders without a crash.

windows_server_automation.purpose: Test-signed derivative install, AUMID activation, product-specific noninteractive GUI/data driver, and cleanup on an ephemeral runner.
limitations: A passing derivative is supplemental diagnostic evidence until the owner approves derivative equivalence for the fixed candidate.

windows_10_11_interactive.purpose: Human-visible UI, Japanese/English rendering, DPI scaling, file dialogs, visual clipping, and normal user close/relaunch.
limitations: Windows Server automation does not prove Windows 10/11 visual behavior.

source_gui_driver.scope: source GUI functional smoke; not fixed MSIX install, visual DPI, certification, or publish proof
